title: Children shifting random number generators with thought
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: technological a random number generator, there are examples where I personally and watched other kids push them sigas sigas of multitudes and held for hours just by using our thoughts.

plain: Between about 2008 and 2010, at Baker Victory Services in Western New York, children were tested on whether they could push random number generators, machines that produce numbers by pure chance, using only their thoughts. Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into a UFO-related programme as a child, tells Michels that he and other kids he watched pushed the results far from chance and "held for hours just by using our thoughts." If true, it would mean children's minds were being trained to affect machines directly.
